reason: Missing rationale entry for wrong option 'c' (Mohs 7). Option 'c' (Mohs 7) is actually correct for quartz mineral, but the correct answer for this specific question is option 'b' (5-6 to 7 depending on brand). Added explanation.

rationale.c: While quartz mineral has Mohs 7, engineered quartz composite hardness varies (5-6 to 7) depending on resin-to-quartz ratio. 7 is the upper bound but not the typical stated hardness for all brands.
